why: The two figures (circle inside triangle, and triangle inside circle) take turns like a chessboard. Row 2 is: triangle-in-circle, circle-in-triangle, so the next is triangle-in-circle. Option 3 shows a triangle inside a circle. Options 1 and 2 have only one shape.
trick: If two figures alternate in a grid, the missing cell is the opposite of its neighbours.
